It was there proposed that the population-mileage formula codified at 49 CFR 1049.2 be revised so that motor carrier terminal area limits at unincorporated communities would be determined by reference to a population-mileage formula generally corresponding to that used for municipalities. The post office continues to be the central point from which the applicable radius is measured. In those cases where there is no post office, the generally recognized business center is the only alternative central point. We affirm these rules proposed in the Interim Report and make them final. We also adhere to the proposition that certificates and permits authorizing service at unincorporated communities confer implied authority to serve those points encompassed by the revised population-mileage formula applicable to unincorporated communities.
